parsed.rationale: Both `MockHLSAVPlayer.play` and `MockPlayer.play` live under test-support paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/`) within the `Playback` package. A `play()` method with an empty signature is the minimal stub any mock of a player protocol must provide; its structural identity is an artefact of the protocol contract being fulfilled, not a sign of accidental duplication. Notably, the context flags report `is_mock: false` for both records despite the file names (`MockHLSAVPlayer`, `MockPlayer`) and paths clearly indicating mock/test-support roles, which suggests the flag is unreliable here and should not be used to override the path-based evidence. Consolidating the two mocks would couple unrelated test suites (`HLSPlayerTests` vs. `PlaybackTestUtilities`) and reduce test isolation.
